title: Full-production spectral discretization to continuum PDE
statement: For the hash-pinned full-production functional and fixed-torus PDE, the P3 package defines the Fourier projector and separates the exact spectral Galerkin residual from the production collocation gradient. Stage 1 verifies stable same-backend spatial self-convergence and the real energy-gradient identity. Stage 2 independently separates RK4 temporal error from cross-grid spatial trajectory error, verifies fourth-order manufactured time convergence, and observes nonincreasing energy on every tested unforced trajectory.
scope: T3 COMPUTABLE-SCAFFOLD. Fixed T3, pinned full-production parameters and positive regularisers, eta_shell=0, analytic nonzero-density manufactured field, CPU complex128. Spatial grids N=8,12,16 with N=24,32 references; finite-time grids N=8,12,16 with N=20,24 references. Stages 1 and 2 only.
falsifier: Source-hash drift, an unstable oversampling reference, nonconvergent collocation-to-Galerkin residual error, failure of the discrete energy-gradient identity, failure of the later finite-time or Hessian/Ritz convergence conditions, or an unexplained hardware/precision discrepancy invalidates the corresponding P3 stage.
no_overclaim: This T3 stage does not supply an independent continuum residual, a completed Galerkin passage, finite-time solution convergence, Hessian or Ritz convergence, CPU/GPU equivalence, complex64 adequacy, convergence of the historical solver, continuum validity of N32/N64/N128 Sector-B runs, minimizer or BCC selection, T5, T6, or T7.
